name: Mimetic – Conversion Rate Optimization
author: colemanhindes

sections.description:
Mimetic audits your storefront and shows you what is hurting conversion. It reviews your products, pages, theme, performance, and tracking, then groups findings by severity so you know what to fix first, right from your WordPress dashboard.

Each issue includes a plain-English explanation. The full report on Mimetic adds estimated revenue impact, a prioritized roadmap, and recommended fixes you approve before anything changes. Your site is never modified without your approval.

This is a thin, open-source client: it starts the audit through Mimetic’s API, polls for results, and links you to your report. The audit engine runs on Mimetic’s servers. No analysis code or credentials are bundled in the plugin.

What it checks

  • Storefront issues across products, pages, theme, performance, and tracking
  • Findings grouped by severity with plain-English explanations
  • Core Web Vitals and performance signals
  • SEO and metadata gaps

Free vs. full report

Running an audit is free and shows your prioritized findings. The full report, with estimated revenue impact, a phased roadmap, complete pass/fail results, and recommended fixes, is unlocked through your Mimetic account at trymimetic.com.

External Services

This plugin relies on a third-party service to function: it connects to the Mimetic API (trymimetic.com) to run your storefront audit. The audit is performed on Mimetic’s servers and the plugin links you to the result.

What it sends, and when:

  • When you click “Run free audit”, the plugin sends the site URL you choose to audit and the email address you enter to the Mimetic API to start the audit.
  • While the audit runs, the plugin sends the resulting audit ID to poll for completion status.
  • No data is sent to Mimetic unless you start an audit.

This service is provided by Mimetic Inc:

  • Service & API: https://trymimetic.com
  • Terms of Service: https://trymimetic.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://trymimetic.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Mimetic in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Confirm the site URL to audit (defaults to your site) and the email address your report should go to.
  4. Click Run free audit. Audits usually take 30 to 45 minutes; your report is also emailed when it is ready.
sections.faq:
Does Mimetic change my site?

No. The audit is read-only. Recommended fixes are applied only when you approve them.

Is my data safe?

The plugin sends your public site URL and the email address you enter to Mimetic’s API to run the audit. See the privacy policy at https://trymimetic.com/privacy.

Do I need a Mimetic account?

You can run a free audit without one. A Mimetic account unlocks the full report and fixes.

How long does an audit take?

Usually 30 to 45 minutes. You can watch live progress on Mimetic, and your report is emailed when it is ready.
